fallback_summary_en: Learn the month cycle while comparing numbered month systems, inflected date forms, regional names, and calendars that divide the year differently.

transparency_slide.description: Show the learner's strongest explanation languages first, then learning languages. Calendar systems and regional month-name systems are context, not universal properties of the language.
transparency_slide.rendering_model: Native-language support blurb plus structured ordered month systems for eligible learning languages.

support_selection.full: Tier 1 or Tier 2 learning language with a rich knowledge-set record.
support_selection.comparison_only: Tier 3 vocabulary-only target, or a canonical source language used only for explanation.
support_selection.unavailable: No required lesson asset exists at the user's trust threshold.

title_policy.notes: The runtime may select a calendar system from locale/profile context, but it must not silently overwrite alternate systems stored in the language record.

eligibility.notes: Tier 1/2 may receive the full lesson. Tier 3 may be selected for the vocabulary/game layer only.

semantic_exposure.notes: Every month surface form resolves through the shared lesson semantic index; alternate calendar systems remain separate semantic concepts.

block_plan.notes: Use each language record's primary month system, with contextual alternate systems available when region/calendar metadata makes them relevant.
Surface numbered-month patterns, alternate calendars, regional month names, and stand-alone vs date-phrase forms only when relevant.

learning_path_policy.notes: Exact ordering can vary by language path; the family itself remains reusable.
